title: Notification regarding regular sitting of the Division Benches & Single Benches.

HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 7th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is hereby informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Hon’ble The Chief Justice is pleased to constitute the regular sitting of the
Division Benches and Single Benches as per the following table with effect from 10.08.2026, until
further order(s):
DIVISION BENCH SINGLE BENCH
Hon’ble The Chief Justice 1. Hon’ble The Chief Justice
2. HMJ A. Bimol Singh
3. HMJ A. Guneshwar Sharma
with
HMI A. Birnol Singh
•
Every Friday, Division Bench shall be of Hon’bie The Chief Justice and Hon’ble Mr. Justice
A. Guneshwar Sharma. If Friday falls on a holiday, Hon’ble The Chief Justice will sit in a
Division Bench with Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on the last working day of
that week prior to Friday.
This issues in supersession of all. earlier notifications in this regard.e
As regards subject for the benches, notification bearing No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/17260-78
dated 7th August, 2026 which has now been issued today (Friday) will operate until further
orders of Hon’ble The Chief Justice.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
